newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower in most maturities.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower in most maturities.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) dipped in most maturities, while the two-month and twelve-month rates were unchanged, traders said on Thursday.
These mirrored the current state of liquidity at the money market, they said.
"Everybody was giving swaps. It's so liquid," said a dealer.
And since Thursday is the end of the reserve week, most banks would be square, prompting banks to adjust downward their swap rates for most of the short term, the dealer said.
PHIBOR represents rates at which banks would be willing to swap their pesos for dollars.
